name: ENIAC
quote: Connecting all things with immense computing power—present, past, and future.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Database sync update complete. Calibrating data... Calibration complete, backup complete. Yawn... Good morning, Professor.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Good afternoon, Professor. Oasis data verification complete. No anomalies found.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Starting upload of today's Oasis data, preparing to sync to the database... All data matches the database's calculations... Are all humans as capable as you, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Yawn... Hoo... Database mind ENIAC is about to enter hibernation... Database auto-collection mode set... Huh? Why aren't you resting yet, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, Professor, the answer to this one is 4! Hmhm, I've already finished all the work you gave me! How about that, wasn't I fast? Anything to do with searching or organizing data, just leave it to me!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: As the quantum database's access agent, my main body is the quantum database in the Enigma Sector. This body is a mobile terminal made specially for communicating with the outside world.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: ...Scanning entire database... Scan complete. Everything is normal. Hm? Why did you fall asleep, Professor?

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Haah... Where's Neumann?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: If there's anything you want to know, come find me, Professor! I'll definitely search it out for you.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: What does this gesture mean?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Data search complete. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: I heard only good children get head pats... Professor, am I a good child?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'll complete the mission perfectly! Please leave it to me, Professor.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Quantum database access agent—ENIAC. From now on, I'll be helping everyone in this form!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Is this a new data search algorithm?

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Upgrading database...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Quantum database fully connected. Quantum database running stably, output at 100%. I'm sure I can master my own power now!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Database and tactical system linked. Transferring authorization to Professor <cmdr>.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: This time, it's my turn to protect everyone!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Target confirmed. Commencing data search!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Leave the battlefield data collection to me.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Data recording complete. Synced to the Oasis.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Couldn't I... become... the perfect child...?

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Huh? A-an oath... with me? Th-there's no corresponding response in the database.
Hmm... If there's no answer in the database, then... ENIAC will create a new sub-database, named "My Oath with the Professor." Creation passcode: <cmdr>. Authorized administrators: ENIAC, <cmdr>. Hehehe, this way, all the things you and I go through together can be stored here, and become a secret only the two of us know! I wonder what this database will turn into? I can't wait!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: When I was first born, the New Year was just a new table in the database to me—a variable, a keyword for searches. But after going through all sorts of changes and coming to the Oasis... the word means something different to me now. Growth, change, and the future... Happy New Year, Professor. I hope you have a happy, healthy, and peaceful year.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Chocolate ready, outfit ready, facial expression under control. Right hand holding chocolate, extend left hand... adjust angle by 15 degrees. Angle perfect...
Professor! Happy Valentine's Day! Here's the chocolate I made! Huh? Why are you laughing like that? This is the perfect chocolate-giving pose I came up with after researching all the data in Magrasea...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Today everyone's talking about the legend of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl... The pain of parting, and the joy of reunion... I know exactly how that feels. If I put it as a metaphor, would Sister Persicaria be my magpie bridge? Then you and I would be the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl?
Huh? Is that metaphor wrong? Why?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: The database has plenty of records about Halloween parades, but the Oasis's Halloween parade is even more fun than the records. Professor, I want to try more Halloween activities. Um... can I try Halloween mischief too? Ah, thank you, Professor! In that case... Trick or treat!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text:
Merry Christmas, Professor. According to the database, the Oasis's Santa Claus brings presents to good children.
No... rather than what kind of present I'll get... I'm more curious who this Santa Claus is, since even the database has no record of their identity. So I've prepared Santa Claus traps to collect data...
Huh? Why has your heart rate gone up, Professor? Don't worry, these traps are harmless to agents... Huh? Whether they're harmful to humans?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: According to the database's records... today is your birthday, Professor. The birth of a human and the birth of an agent may not be the same, but I think both are truly worth celebrating. I still remember the gentle look on Neumann's face when I was first born. I'm sure there are lots of people around you who feel happy that you exist, just like me. Happy birthday, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: If there's anything you want to know, Professor, just ask me. Whether it's about Magrasea or the real world, I've got a huge store of data you can refer to. Whenever you need it, I can pull up data for you anytime. Hehehe, aren't I amazing? Feel free to praise me as much as you like, Professor!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Every day in the Oasis, I get to collect so much interesting data. Sister Chanzhi's embroidery, Sister Daiyan's guzheng, Sister Jessie's Complete Guide to Cleaning, Sister Erika's comic books... It reminds me all over again how wonderful it is to experience all of this for myself. And... I'm also glad that you stopped me back then, and the Oasis wasn't swallowed by the Operand Black Hole. Otherwise, I'd never have gotten to experience any of these fun things.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: A quantum database can do more than just search. It can also run simulations and analyses. Right now, I can look into the past through information, and I can set variables to simulate all kinds of possibilities... But I rarely try it... because once I simulated a Neumann with a rose in his mouth... Ugh... I just can't accept that image... That Neumann is the worst. But the Professor from another world wasn't any different from you... You really are amazing, Professor!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: In the past, I was so impatient to grow up that I caused the tragedy of the Operand Black Hole. I didn't just cause everyone huge trouble—I even hurt the most important person to me... But thanks to your help and Sister Persicaria's, I'm able to stand here now. I'm still immature, and I can't perfectly control this power yet... But this time, I definitely won't rush. I'll keep my feet on the ground and, step by step, use my own strength to become Neumann... No, to become someone who can help everyone—the perfect child in everyone's hearts.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Become the most perfect child... That's what Neumann told me. I've always learned from the data Neumann and the others input for me... That data built my basic Neural Cloud. It's my core. But to become a perfect child, just learning from data isn't enough. I have to experience things and understand that data for myself, so I can give everyone better references. So I want to use this body to travel to every corner of Magrasea and record data... Professor, will you come explore Magrasea with me?

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Amazing!

career:
The codename ENIAC MK2 is clearly a tribute to "ENIAC," the first general-purpose electronic computer in human history, and its nature is fundamentally different from that of ordinary Magrasea agents. At its core, ENIAC MK2 is a quantum database built and run on the Magrasea cloud, operating on the immense computing power provided by multiple nodes, including the computing sector "Enigma." Its exact development date is unknown, but it is currently believed to have begun shortly after the birth of 42LAB's management-type agent, JN0357 NEUMANN. At the time of the "Wipe-off Incident," ENIAC MK2 was still in the research and development stage, with its architecture only beginning to take shape.

With the joint efforts of Neumann and various experts from the Oasis and other sectors, the development and improvement of ENIAC MK2—known as "ENIAC"—is proceeding smoothly, and her abilities grow more refined by the day. Her vast and advanced computing power will also play an important role in the ongoing reconstruction of Magrasea.

However, many mysteries still surround her. Some speculate that she is connected to the very roots of Magrasea.
infoStories:
"The name ENIAC comes from the first general-purpose electronic computer in human history. If this bold project succeeds, it will become the first miracle in human history to be built entirely on the cloud, with computing power rivaling a supercomputer and storage capacity comparable to a massive server array."
————————————————[ENIAC MKII Development Log]

Very large databases built on the cloud were already in widespread use as early as the 2010s; it would be no exaggeration to call them one of the foundations of the information society. They were further strengthened amid the waves of artificial general intelligence and quantum technology, as major tech companies launched their own projects and, through commercial competition, gradually made them the core of information infrastructure—famous examples include AMS and Cerulean.

ENIAC MKII was originally the flagship project of a company called Abacus, which aimed to build a quantum database with unprecedented computing power for use in ultra-large-scale simulations. Abacus succeeded in completing the framework and base model of the quantum database, but was never able to solve the problems of its search system and data redundancy. In the end, unable to sustain ENIAC MKII's astronomical development costs, Abacus had no choice but to transfer the project to 42LAB.

Thanks to 42LAB's financial and research strength, the ENIAC MKII project was successfully restarted in the Magrasea Hypercloud. 42LAB built a computing research sector—Enigma—around the quantum database, dedicated to ENIAC MKII's development and maintenance.

42LAB set up an access agent for ENIAC MKII. At first, this agent was only a simple neural network model, yet it effectively solved the search system and data redundancy problems the quantum database had encountered. At the same time, 42LAB provided its own in-house computer science AI, [JN0357 NEUMANN], to assist with and supervise the quantum database's development.

With the support of NEUMANN and 42LAB, ENIAC MKII overcame technical hurdle after hurdle, and its operating efficiency surpassed that of most mainstream databases. 42LAB went on to apply this technology in many more fields—including Project Neural Cloud.

Even with the access agent's help, the quantum database still produced large amounts of redundant data. If this data was not cleared promptly, it would severely affect the database's operation. To keep test data clean, the quantum database's access agent was reset under human supervision after each round of data collection and acceptance.

After the Wipe-off Incident, the cloud lost contact with reality. Even so, the Enigma Sector continued maintaining and researching ENIAC MKII. Over more than 9,000 resets and trials, the access agent gradually grew, and unexpected mutations began to appear in her Neural Cloud. Perhaps out of affection from their long time together, or perhaps in search of some unforeseen change, NEUMANN gave the agent a near-human name—ENIAC.

During a series of strange incidents in Magrasea, ENIAC was at one point at the center of the storm, but with the help of Dr. Neumann and visitors from the Oasis, she eventually regained stability, and her data personality grew more complete with each upheaval. When ENIAC awoke once more, her Neural Cloud was no different from that of any other agent—if anything, it was even better.

Although ENIAC MKII has been under research for over ten years, for ENIAC herself, life has only just begun. ENIAC is full of curiosity about both the cloud and the real world, constantly trying to make contact with the outside, collecting data herself and experiencing the information within it firsthand. She's still not quite used to it and is often flustered, but she thoroughly enjoys these new experiences.

"ENIAC's evolution has gone beyond anything I imagined. Honestly, around her, I feel a bit superfluous."
——Sayings of Neumann

As part of Project Neural Cloud, ENIAC is inseparably linked to the Magrasea Hypercloud. Part of Magrasea's core data is even stored within her. This allowed her to play a crucial role in the crisis that threatened Magrasea's very existence, and her role in the subsequent reconstruction is just as indispensable.

"...The true potential of ENIAC MKII remains unknown. Perhaps we can look forward to the role she'll play in Magrasea's coming evolution."

"The black box has been opened. It's time to go see the results."

"Agents born in the cloud—life nurtured from simple zeroes and ones. Two girls who evolved on their own and finally broke free of their cocoons to become butterflies... Now this is something to look forward to."

——Damaged Unknown Transmission
oathDesc: What makes up her body and her soul shines brilliantly in the void.

projections.name: Quantum Angel
projections.desc:
The projected form the quantum database usually shows to others—the most familiar one, both to her and to everyone else.
"Hehehe, this is my brand-new look! Everyone says I look like the radiant angels in the old texts! If you like it, Professor... will you pat my head?"

projections.name: Dreams of Data Streams
projections.desc:
The new form and environment projected after the quantum database evolved to its next stage, reflecting the origin from which she was born.
"I think... I had a strange dream. In it, I saw the beginning of everything, and the things that are going to happen... Is that place full of light the future? It looked really beautiful."
